set.body: Show the practical consequence of making the RDM optional. For a large-q problem, compute selected contrasts, selected distance edges, and fixed linear RSA coefficients without materializing the full q(q+1)/2 geometry at every location. Acceptance: independent numerical parity with materialization where feasible, peak-memory and runtime receipts after warm-up and repetition, dimensional regime and hardware recorded, proof that the full form was not materialized, and honest budgets for every exposed public path.
set.title: Gate 5: certify query-first execution at large condition count
